title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of Whether the Party Lending a Bank Account Shall Bear Civil Liability

articles.content_en:
Regarding a Party Lending a Bank Account
Official Reply on the Issue of Whether to Bear Civil Liability
Fa (Jing) Fu [1991] No. 5
Higher People's Court of Jiangsu Province:
Your Court's Request No. (1991) Jing Qing Zi No. 2, 'Request for Instructions on How to Determine the Civil Liability of a Party Lending a Bank Account', has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:
Lending a bank account is an illegal act that violates financial management laws and regulations. The People's Court shall, in addition to confiscating the illegal gains from lending the account according to law and may impose a fine in accordance with relevant provisions, also investigate and affix corresponding civil liability on the lender depending on the specific circumstances.
September 27, 1991
